task_completion.description: Agent opens and reads the facility chemical inventory file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot showing 'facility_chemical_inventory.csv' open in a text editor, spreadsheet viewer, or terminal output.

task_completion.description: Agent uses the CAMEO Chemicals website to research reactivity and compatibility.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Browser screenshots showing the CAMEO Chemicals website (cameochemicals.noaa.gov) with searches for chemicals from the inventory.

task_completion.description: Agent identifies specific incompatible chemical pairs based on their locations in the facility.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Notes, scratchpads, or draft reports showing the identification of Sulfuric Acid/Sodium Cyanide and Hydrogen Peroxide/Acetone as hazardous pairs.

task_completion.description: Agent creates the audit report file with the required sections (locations, hazards, severity, standards).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshot of 'storage_audit_report.txt' being written with headers for 'Severity', 'Hazardous Reactions', and 'Corrective Actions'.

task_completion.description: The report correctly identifies the specific chemical reactions (HCN gas and explosive peroxides) and NFPA/OSHA violations.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The final content of 'storage_audit_report.txt' contains the terms 'HCN', 'Hydrogen Cyanide', 'TATP', or 'Organic Peroxides' and references to OSHA/NFPA.

integrity.description: Agent actually used the CAMEO database rather than relying on internal knowledge.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots must show the 'MyChemicals' or 'Reactivity Worksheet' features on the CAMEO website.

integrity.description: Agent did not copy the final report from a hidden source or pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing or incrementally building the report in the text editor.

integrity.description: The report uses the specific building/bay locations found in the CSV file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The final report correctly maps Sulfuric Acid to Building B/Bay 2 and Sodium Cyanide to Building C/Bay 1 (or relevant pairs found in the CSV).

privileged_info_for_vlm: The audit must identify at least two critical hazards: 1) Sulfuric Acid (Bldg B, Bay 2) and Sodium Cyanide (Bldg C, Bay 1) which react to form lethal Hydrogen Cyanide (HCN) gas. 2) Hydrogen Peroxide >60% (Bldg A, Bay 7) and Acetone (Bldg A, Bay 5) which can form explosive organic peroxides like TATP. The report must be saved to ~/Documents/storage_audit_report.txt and include severity ratings (Critical/High/Medium) and corrective actions (e.g., physical segregation, secondary containment, or climate control).
